Even if you believe your registration is current, take a few minutes to verify your information before the deadline. Use Georgia’s My Voter Page to: ✓ Check your registration status ✓ Confirm your address ✓ Find election information ✓ Access your sample ballot and voting-location information A few minutes today can help make sure your information is correct before voting begins. Road to November: Stay informed. Know the dates. Make your plan. #RoadToNovember #GeorgiaVoters #VoterRegistration #District34 #election
